hints.title: Chebyshev Distance
hints.text: In a grid with 8-directional movement, the minimum time to reach (fx, fy) from (sx, sy) is max(abs(sx - fx), abs(sy - fy)).

hints.title: Wandering Invariant
hints.text: If t >= min_time, one can usually waste surplus seconds by stepping back and forth between adjacent cells.

hints.title: Single Step Trap
hints.text: If start and destination are identical and t = 1, one must make a move to an adjacent cell and cannot return within 1 second.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all grid movements takes exponential time for large coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compute Chebyshev distance and guard the edge case where distance is zero and t is one.
